E1_E23.what: T1b of fold 0 exactly as it was evaluated in extension_v18b (selected candidate of reports/extension_v18/gapfree/select_0.json, templates and search box from the fold-0 field training annotations, S refitted from its own fold-0 TRAIN detections) applied to the six E23 LH FRT doors (120 images; reports/e23_openset_v3/manifest.jsonl, the images the learned fold-0 detector was given).

E2_unseen_class.what: T1b in the unseen-class condition of the manuscript (section 3.3), five folds, each of the eight classes c removed (40 runs): templates and search box from the field training annotations of the split WITHOUT the image of class c (7 images); candidate selected by the order-free validation PCK8 on the validation annotations WITHOUT class c (7 images), ties by lower median error and then the earlier candidate; S fitted from the diagnostic's own detections on the TRAIN sessions WITHOUT class c. The ten candidates, the 500 px rule, the 30 mm rule and the door vote are unchanged.
E2_unseen_class.decisions: TEST doors of the fold judged (i) with the seven-value CAD list: doors of c should be rejected, the other doors identified; (ii) after adding D_c to the list with the same detections and S: doors of c should be identified.
E2_unseen_class.report: Totals over the 40 runs and per removed class: unregistered doors rejected (of 361) and the classes accepted doors go to; doors identified after registration (of 361); registered-door decisions correct / rejected / wrong (of 2,527) in (i) and in (ii); smallest distance of a measured unregistered image to a registered CAD value; the selected candidate and S of every run; for every run, how many of the annotated corner holes of class c (all its field annotations) lie inside the search box of the selected candidate.

E3_fixed_settings.what: Each of the six NCC candidates of T1b (r = 16, 24, 32; m = 40, 80) used in all splits without the selection step: detection with the 500 px rule on the TRAIN and TEST frames, own S per split, decisions as T1b.
E3_fixed_settings.report: Doors identified in five folds (of 361) and in the temporal split (of 133) for each of the six settings, with rejected and wrong doors; the range over the settings.

claim_rule: Everything is reported whatever its direction; Table 3 keeps the registered rows and the T1b row. E1, with R = E23 doors rejected with the eight-value list and I = E23 doors identified after registration (of 6): (a) if I <= 1 the manuscript states that the 500 px condition corresponds to about 581 mm and presupposes the dimension range of the registered classes, gives R and I, and states that the learned detector, which detects each hole separately, has no such premise (6 and 6); (b) if I = 6 the manuscript states that the condition did not prevent the identification, gives the pixel scale, R and I; (c) otherwise both counts are given with the measured D. E2, with U = unregistered doors rejected and N = doors identified after registration (of 361 each): (a) if U >= 343 and N >= 343 the manuscript states that the diagnostic with the classical detector also rejected unregistered doors and identified them after CAD registration, so that within the dimension range of the registered classes these properties belong to the separation structure and not to the learned detector, and the sentence of section 4.5 that this condition was not evaluated is replaced; (b) if U < 300 or N < 300 the manuscript gives both counts and the classes in which the diagnostic failed (with the search-box coverage if that explains it) and states that in this condition the learned detector did better; (c) otherwise both counts are given with the per-class breakdown and neither statement is made. E3: the range over the six settings is given in section 4.2; if the smallest five-fold count is below 343 the manuscript says that the result depends on the setting. The statement of section 4.2 and of the conclusion that a learned detector was not shown to be necessary for the identification of registered classes is kept unless E3 contradicts it (largest five-fold count below 343).
